Trainers · teachers · in French

Question bank and quiz maker

Your questions in one tagged bank (multiple choice with one or several right answers, true or false, short answer, difficulty, explanation). Draw a quiz in one click by tags and difficulty, print the paper with a separate answer key, enter each learner's answers and the mark is computed; short answers that do not match are left for you to decide. Statistics show success per question and per tag, questions that are too easy or too hard and the wrong answer chosen most often. Papers can be anonymous or use a nickname; results can be exported and erased at any time. No questions supplied.
